scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp index.html dist/index.html && (cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r assets/* dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist/app-debug.apk || cp .build-outputs/app-debug.apk dist/app-debug.apk || echo 'No APK found')
